name: CI/CD
title: Modern CI/CD Pipeline
headline: A Blueprint for Automated QA & Deployment
summary: A robust reference implementation of industry-standard CI/CD workflows. While demonstrated on a Vue 3 stack, the architecture serves as a portable template for enforcing code quality, performance audits, and automated deployments in most modern ecosystems.

rationale.title: Shift-Left Testing
rationale.description: Catch bugs before they reach the repo by enforcing formatting, linting and Unit Tests locally via Husky git hooks.

rationale.title: Automated Quality Gates
rationale.description: Prevent UX regressions with Lighthouse CI audits that block deployments if performance or accessibility scores drop.

rationale.title: Atomic Deployments
rationale.description: Ensure the live site only updates after all quality gates pass, maintaining a stable production environment.
